description: ACCDB: seed T(ID PK, D DATETIME2); test CreateQueryDef with PARAMETERS p DateTime2 (SELECT, BETWEEN, INSERT), plus PARAMETERS p DateTimeExtended (syntax discriminator) and PARAMETERS p DateTime / Text(42). Inspects Parameter.Name/Type/Direction/Value, binds boundary ISO strings, VT_DATE, Null, and invalid 'not-a-date'; keeps all pages after CreateQueryDef, Execute, pause, Close.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, D DATETIME2)
PARAMETERS p DateTime2; SELECT ID, D, p AS pv, VarType(p) AS vt, TypeName(p) AS tn FROM T WHERE D = p ORDER BY ID;
PARAMETERS p DateTimeExtended; SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D = p;
PARAMETERS pLo DateTime2, pHi DateTime2; SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D BETWEEN pLo AND pHi ORDER BY ID;
PARAMETERS pid Long, pv DateTime2; INSERT INTO T (ID, D) VALUES (pid, pv);
PARAMETERS p DateTime; SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE D = p ORDER BY ID;
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE ID = 99
